title: Give every repo a living roadmap page
why: The process behind this page, made repeatable: audit the repo, turn the findings into phased steps with a plain why and an ask for each, publish one page per repo, and update it in place as lanes land. A /roadmap skill in claude-settings would build it from docs/plans and docs/debts, and the merge step would tick off the steps it completes. It pairs with the health view: health shows how the repo is, the roadmap shows what's next.
